title: Draft genome sequence of Afipia carboxidovorans strain SH125
description: This project contains the draft genome sequence of Afipia carboxidovorans strain SH125. Afipia carboxidovorans strain SH125 was newly isolated from the anammox bioreactor fed with gaseous nitrous oxide. The strain exhibited a nitrous oxide reduction activity. The draft genome information will help investigate nitrogen metabolisms of this strain in natural and engineered environments.
center: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology
samples: Draft genome sequence of Afipia carboxidovorans strain SH125
